title: SBW Configure
description: A simple mod that interferes with SBW to add a couple of features which are missing when creating modpacks or PvE games
body:
A simple mod that interferes with SBW to add a couple of features which are missing when creating modpacks or PvE games

Download, open your config, and edit as much as you like!

## Features:

### Linking the heating of the weapon to the player

Similar to TacZ, the heat will be synchronized between all weapons in the inventory.

### Disabling the mechanics of weapon perks

The perks themselves are not removed, but when installed on a weapon, they will not be displayed and will stop working.

### Disabling head shots

Headshots will not be registered at all

### Disabling the search for blocks for auto-landing

Useful for servers. The function disables the helicopter's every tick search within a 30-block radius for auto-landing blocks. However, the impact on performance is debatable, as tests were done using Spark, and on my LDS, the difference reached up to 3 TPS per Entity

### Setting up damage modifiers on all vehicles

A feature for modpackers that allows you to customize how vehicles take damage. 
In theory, it works with all vehicles, but otherwise, I recommend checking the parameters built into the vehicle. You can find them in the `.json` parameter `DamageModifiers`. The original SBW `.json` files are stored in `data\superbwarfare\sbw\vehicles`, and for example, in the [ashvehicle](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ashvehicle) addon, they are located here: `data\ashvehicle\sbw\vehicles\`
